## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Visual changes

Add screenshots or recordings for interface changes. Write "Not applicable" if

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] No credentials, local environment files, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and migrations are updated where needed.
